root_problem: Eliminate every residual Work-exclusive or protected-primary execution dependency from the policy-hardening, integration, bridge, and O-facing verification path while preserving proof strength, exact scope/provenance, and zero incremental cost.

slice.problem: Continual-learning progress must survive recurring Chat invocations without relying on Work-only session continuity while retaining exact provenance and proof strength.

protocol: Bind each checkpoint to role, phase, authority blob identities, preserved root identity, and explicit input provenance.
Make each invocation exactly one bounded update with a deterministic idempotency identity derived from the prior compatible checkpoint identity plus the declared slice intent.
Separate observations and evidence from inference and promotion decisions; never treat unverified claims as learned facts.
Persist the completed effect, local validation result, unresolved residual, and exact next action; require exact repository readback before normal return.
When prior state is missing or incompatible with current authority/root identities, branch fresh for the current root rather than importing stale cross-root semantics.
Use only role-authorized GitHub or public zero-cost surfaces; introduce no Work-exclusive or finite-quota dependency.

verification.claim: Design-level bounded role-local protocol candidate only; this is not proof that the Phase-1 root is solved.

continuation: On the next invocation, resolve the newest compatible continual_learning checkpoint under the current authority and root identities, then test exactly one concrete state transition against the protocol's idempotency, provenance-separation, and exact-readback invariants; do not broaden to a second leaf.
